summary: Manager split: Team Approvals and My Team
description: Managers get two sidebar items: Team Approvals (the pending queue and recent decisions, in the Balance Overrides card style) and My Team (a grid of cards, one per direct report; a card opens that person's requests in a popup). Managers do not see balances. Presentation and navigation only: no new query, no migration, no role or required feature changes (golden rule). The scope stays in SQL (u.manager_id = the session user).

summary: Separate nav items for Team Approvals and My Team
description: nav.ts gains a manager-only My Team item (/approvals/team) with its own white icon; the TeamTabs component is removed; page titles and the demo checklist are updated. URLs are unchanged, so no redirects.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A manager sees Dashboard, Team Approvals and My Team in the sidebar; employees and HR admins never see My Team. 2. /approvals highlights Team Approvals and /approvals/team and /approvals/team/<id> highlight My Team, with the top bar title matching. 3. There are no tabs on either page. 4. My Team has an icon different from Team Approvals.

summary: Team Approvals in the Balance Overrides card style
description: Pending requests and Recently decided become cards (icon, title, count chip); each request is a row with the person, the dates written with the month name, the status and the actions, with dividers from lg; a light note strip says why a request cannot be approved (over balance, no balance record, negative balance). An in-balance request has no note: managers do not see balances. Row layout pieces are shared with Balance Overrides (row-layout.tsx).
acceptance_criteria: 1. Dates read like 'Nov 2 to Nov 6, 2026', never ISO. 2. The chips read 'N pending' and 'N recent'. 3. An over-balance request still shows 'Waiting for HR override' with Reject only; no balance record and negative balance also Reject only. 4. Approve and Reject behave as before. 5. No sideways scroll at 375 and 320 px, including a long unbroken word in a reason. 6. Balance Overrides is unchanged.

summary: My Team as a card grid with a member popup
description: Each direct report is a card (name, status, pending chip, last request; no balances) in a wrapping grid whose last row fills the width. A card links to /approvals/team?member=<id>, which opens a modal dialog with the person's filters and requests, no balances (the same read as /approvals/team/<id>). The old member page stays.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Cards fill every row at 375, 768 and 1440 px. 2. Clicking a card opens the popup; Escape, a backdrop click and Close return to My Team. 3. Filters, pagination and clear filters keep the popup open. 4. Another team's id, a missing or deleted person, the manager themself and a malformed id show the same 'couldn't find that person' message. 5. The page reads at most 2 statements. 6. Approve and Reject work inside the popup.
